subject: Upcoming Birthday Party Invitation
body: Dear friends, I hope this email finds you well. I am excited to invite you to my upcoming birthday party on Saturday, 20th November. The party will start at 7 PM at my house and will feature live music, delicious food, and fun games. Please RSVP by 15th November so I can make necessary arrangements. I look forward to celebrating with all of you! Best regards, [Your Name]
